design_problem: Globally-distributed notification platform. 5B sends/day at peak. Multi-region failover with 60s RTO. Exactly-once dedup within 24h. <2s e2e p99.
summary: 64-minute system design review for a 5B/day globally-distributed notification platform. Strong on real-world distributed systems: dedup, replication, retry, circuit breakers, capacity planning. Identified split-brain as the corner case that scares him most, but only after Sara pushed for it. Honest that he hasn't implemented fencing from scratch — Pageform's failover relies on DNS, not explicit lease/generation. Sara recommended Strong Hire at L6 with a mentorship pairing on formal methods (Devon, Principal).
